objective: Certificar en modo READ_ONLY la UAT R3 de Gate12N ya integrada y con quality_gate PASS. Confirmar que el candidato SOC-00001 regreso al baseline, que no quedaron Personas/Vinculos UAT12N, que la FK permanece trusted y que el archivo UAT corresponde al flujo exacto crear Persona -> vincular -> validar -> desvincular -> cleanup. No repetir la UAT ni ejecutar mutaciones.

queries.name: uat_r3_cert_candidate
queries.sql: SELECT CONVERT(varchar(36),SocioID) AS SocioID,CONVERT(varchar(36),EmpresaID) AS UnidadNegocioID,NumeroSocio,Estatus,Activo,PersonaID,ClienteCRMID FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE SocioID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'62CA4D8A-F4B7-4C66-BE8C-2C13C7445A58') AND EmpresaID=CONVERT(uniqueidentifier,N'19E076FB-C6DE-4EA5-84AB-1CAA9E86082C');

queries.name: uat_r3_cert_counts
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona) AS total_personas,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo) AS total_vinculos,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Socios WHERE PersonaID IS NOT NULL) AS socios_vinculados;

queries.name: uat_r3_cert_residuals
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Gobierno_Persona WHERE RFC LIKE N'UAT12N%') AS personas_uat12n,(SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.Gobierno_PersonaVinculo v INNER JOIN dbo.Gobierno_Persona p ON p.PersonaID=v.PersonaID WHERE p.RFC LIKE N'UAT12N%') AS vinculos_uat12n;

constraints: No permission role user menu company or unit changes
Certification must fail closed if any residue remains
